tests.name: Multi-Hop — Single Record Corruption
tests.detail: 3-stage pipeline: Stage 2 corrupts 1 of 20 records. Stage 3 (YON): 20/21 records recovered (95%). Stage 3 (JSON): 0/20 records recovered (total failure). YON isolates corruption to the affected line. JSON's structural integrity cascades.

tests.name: Multi-Hop — 3 Records Corrupted
tests.detail: 3 corruption points injected at indices [3, 10, 17]. YON recovered 18/21 records. JSON: 0/20. Each YON corruption is an independent line failure. JSON corruption is always structural.

tests.name: Multi-Hop — Structural Corruption Cascade

comparison.delta: YON: 1 line lost | JSON: all 20 records lost

tests.detail: Corrupting YON's @ prefix: loses 1 line, others parse normally (20 survived). Corrupting JSON's [ bracket: structural cascade, 0 records recoverable. Format topology determines blast radius — flat > nested for resilience.

tests.name: Multi-Hop — Append-Only Stream Recovery
tests.detail: Append-only stream with corruption at record 10. Pre-corruption: 10/10 records survived. Post-corruption: 9/9 records survived. Mid-stream corruption does not poison the stream — both past and future records are safe.
